data.title: Kalshi to Allow Leveraged Futures Bets With Bitcoin-Backed Loans
data.description: Prediction markets platform Kalshi Inc. will offer some clients the ability to post collateral for leveraged perpetual-futures trades using cryptocurrencies, under a new arrangement with digital-asset custodian BitGo Holdings Inc.
